tool.title: Read a pull request's checks (GitHub)
tool.description: Read the check runs of one pull request and their state.

inputs.name: number
inputs.description: Absent: the change proposal of the current branch.

outputs.name: checks
outputs.description: One line per check run: name, state, elapsed time, link.

remedies.none: No declared Tool reaches the GitHub API another way. A session that provides the GitHub MCP server can use it instead.
